title: Equisetum arvense tincture for medicinal use
intro: Equisetum arvense tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the horsetail plant, which is known for its high silica content. This preparation is commonly used in herbalism to support bone health, skin integrity, and joint function due to its mineral-rich profile. It is also believed to aid in detoxification and may help with conditions like arthritis and respiratory issues. The tincture is typically taken in small doses, often diluted in water or another liquid, to avoid irritation. Its historical use dates back to ancient times, where it was valued for its healing properties.
